title: NetworkPolicy i CIS benchmark
summary: NetworkPolicy kao firewall klastera (default deny, izolacija namespaceova, egress kontrola) i CIS benchmark sa kube-bench, uz bezbjedne ispravke static Pod manifesta i kubelet konfiguracije.
summary_en: NetworkPolicy as the cluster firewall (default deny, namespace isolation, egress control) and the CIS benchmark with kube-bench, with safe fixes to static Pod manifests and kubelet configuration.
